lines.label: B1
lines.reason: This is a real crease of about 24 deg between the short web (patches 1/2) and the top flange (13/6). The section is a sharp kink, not a roll. The line is on the convex outer skin (the patch-1 side). Across 33 stations, its distance to the nearest outer-skin point has a median of 0.10 mm and a maximum of 0.25 mm. In the 25/50/75% sections the apex x sits on the outer corner. The line is parallel to the fold (direction about z). The fold is visible from z = -76.4 to -7.5 (69 mm). Below z = -76.5 only the flange tab with a hole remains, with no web, so the fold is absent there. The line runs from -75.7 to -8.7 (67 mm), which is about 97% coverage.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: This is a real crease of about 21 deg between the short flat (patches 23/21, about 5 mm wide, angled 24 deg from the web) and the web (patches 1/2). The section shows a distinct kink. The line is on the convex outer skin (the patch-2 side). Across 33 stations, its distance to skin points has a median of 0.12 mm and a maximum of 0.32 mm. The 1.02 mm figure in the 75% section is a gap in the point sampling; the station median confirms the line is on the apex. The line is parallel to the fold. The fold is visible from about -76.4 to -7.5 and the line runs from -75.0 to -8.5 (66.5 mm), about 96% coverage. B1 and B2 together form an S-shaped step (a joggle-like offset), so they count as 2 bends. Not counted as bends: the main body, which is a smooth rolled cylinder (circle fit R = 30.08 mm at mid-surface, residual flat to about 0.1 mm over about 160 deg, no facets or creases), and the smooth arc-to-flat transition of about 6 deg at patches 21/23.
